title: read a bar chart
seam: each bar (the drawn bar, full height): data-bar="<key>" and data-value="<value>"
each bar's column hit area (bar + its name, the whole column height, at least the minimum target width): data-column="<key>"; tapping it answers
each y-axis tick label: data-tick="<number>", centred at that value's height
the zero baseline is the bottom of every bar
brief: KIND: data visualisation. Reading a bar chart.

CHART: vertical bars of Studio.params.data (value = how many), growing in once on first paint; a y-axis with numeric ticks and light gridlines at a sensible step, the axis title (yaxis), each bar's name under it (the string with the bar's key).
Bar heights EXACTLY proportional to value on the same scale as the ticks (baseline 0).
QUESTION: show ask. The child taps a column -> Studio.answer("<key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict (right / wrong); on correct Studio.done() and the done text.
Every bar looks identical (same colour, same style) before the child answers: no hint of the answer.
antiPatterns: tick labels placed as evenly spaced text instead of at their value's height
a tap target that is only the bar (a short bar becomes a tiny target): the column is the target
the tallest bar coloured or animated differently before the answer
